import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem

def read_frag_xyz(path):
    with open(path) as f:
        lines = f.read().splitlines()
    n = int(lines[0])
    atoms = []
    for ln in lines[2:2+n]:
        p = ln.split()
        atoms.append((p[0], np.array([float(p[1]), float(p[2]), float(p[3])])))
    return atoms

def rot_align(v1, v2):
    """rotation matrix aligning unit vector v1 to unit vector v2"""
    v1 = v1/np.linalg.norm(v1); v2 = v2/np.linalg.norm(v2)
    c = np.dot(v1,v2)
    if c > 0.999999: return np.eye(3)
    if c < -0.999999:
        # 180 deg: pick any perpendicular axis
        axis = np.cross(v1, [1,0,0])
        if np.linalg.norm(axis) < 1e-6: axis = np.cross(v1,[0,1,0])
        axis = axis/np.linalg.norm(axis)
        K = np.array([[0,-axis[2],axis[1]],[axis[2],0,-axis[0]],[-axis[1],axis[0],0]])
